arguments.request_text: Build a separate empty mall test map for future PIE tests, with a ground floor and second-floor central atrium/gallery so the user can test the scale. Use 4m clear room height and0.5m between floors reserved for structure/HVAC, giving4.5m floor-to-floor spacing. Do not model HVAC internals. Follow the user's shopping-mall references; the central atrium should be lively and inviting through daylight, clean marble flooring, planted areas, seating, and the already animated Hebe fountain. Include enterable store shells and use imported retail kit components. Use supplied balcony straight/corner modules and originalmarbletexture; arrange sensible continuous walkable floors and guarded openings. Install one working up/down450cm-escalator pair between floors, with unobstructed walking approaches and departures. No NPCs, merchants, selling gameplay, or signage in this iteration. Design repeatable floor modules and organize floor/roof/planting/retail actors so it can grow to3-5floors later; make the current roof/skylight removable. Keep the existing player/flashlight animations and original demo map unchanged. Save the completed map as /Game/Environment/Mall/Maps/Lvl_MallAtrium_Test, set an appropriate PlayerStart and use the existing ThirdPerson GameMode for movement tests. This is an environment scale test with real importedassets, not only bare checkerboard geometry. Use sensible lighting and practical collision. Verify visually and report actual layout bounds, player start, actor groups, escalator actor names/origins, store entry points and saved map path.
arguments.short_description: Build expandable two-floor mall atrium test map

References include derelict areas as overall architecture guidance; defer damage/abandonment to later wings.

Maintain genuine4m clear height under450cm gallery floors; slab undersides400cm above lowerwalkingfloor.
